LanguageData.GG_AlliedWithScarab:
After many discussion and debates between you and the leaders of SCARAB, they now realise you are an asset to them, not a threat. You've shown them that the grey goo they've unleashed has become a far greater existential threat than the fungus infection could ever have been.

In order to help fight back against the goo, SCARAB are sending you some higher tech equipment to help you take part in the fight!

They are giving you:

{0}

Be careful! If you betray or otherwise alienate SCARAB, they may cut off your access to the database!
